title: RPG Battle Arena
description:
```
 Warrior Brakka  HP ███████░░░ 70/100
 Mage Ilsa       HP ████░░░░░░ 40/100  MP 30
Ilsa casts Fireball! Brakka takes 28 damage (burning 3 turns)
```
requirements: Status effects as polymorphic objects (`Poison`, `Burn`, `Shield`, `Stun`) with `apply()`, `tick()`, `expired()`
AI vs AI or player-controlled team battle with HP bars
Movement/attack styles via composition (strategy) rather than more subclasses
